nodes.text: 13C NMR indicates compound has both aromatic and aliphatic components

support.quote: The 13C NMR spectra provide chemical shift values that suggest the presence of aromatic carbons (160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, 124.85) and aliphatic carbons (57.20, 41.00, 39.20, 34.00, 24.56, 19.40, 16.60). nodes.text: 1H NMR shows aromatic protons at 7.04 ppm and aliphatic signals including doublet at 1.12 ppm, singlets at 2.21 and 2.34 ppm, and a CH at 4.01 ppm
1H NMR suggests presence of methyl and methylene groups alongside aromatic ring

support.quote: The signals at 1.12 ppm (doublet), 2.04 ppm (doublet of doublets), 2.21 ppm (singlet), 2.34 ppm (singlet), 2.70 ppm (doublet of doublets of quartets), and 4.01 ppm (doublet of doublets) suggest the presence of aliphatic groups, possibly including methyl and methylene groups.

nodes.text: HSQC NMR correlates aromatic protons (7.04-7.06 ppm) with aromatic carbons (124.9-130.4 ppm) and aliphatic protons with aliphatic carbons
Compound is CC(C)C1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O (ibuprofen-like structure with isopropyl and carboxylic acid on benzene)
